note.sr: Ono što posle prijema 2026-10-23 ostaje nerazrešeno. Svaka stavka kaže šta je pouzdano, šta nije i ko to može da potvrdi. Nerazrešeno se ne pogađa i ne briše — stoji ovde dok ne stigne odgovor.
note.en: What remains unresolved after the 2026-10-23 intake. Each item states what is reliable, what is not, and who can confirm it. Unresolved items are neither guessed nor deleted — they stand here until an answer arrives.

items.sr: Indeks 136/26 vodi se u dva tima: u T05 (Dom omladine) i u novom T68 (Zgrada tehničkih fakulteta). Podnesak od 19.10. sa terena potpisuje grupu 155/26 · 130/26 · 136/26.
items.en: Index 136/26 appears in two teams: T05 (Dom omladine) and the new T68 (Faculties of Engineering). The field submission of 19 Oct is signed by the group 155/26 · 130/26 · 136/26.
items.askEn: Holder of 136/26: which team are you in?

items.sr: T70: naslov mejla podneska nosi 64/2026, telo istog mejla 62/2026. Indeks 62/2026 već pripada drugom studentu u T28, a 64/2026 u T11.
items.en: T70: the submission’s mail subject says 64/2026, the body of the same mail says 62/2026. Index 62/2026 already belongs to another student in T28, and 64/2026 in T11.
items.askSr: T70: koji je tačan broj indeksa?

items.sr: T28: podnesak vezuje indekse 33 i 62 za prezimena obrnuto od registra. Razlikuje se i pisanje jednog od ta dva prezimena.
items.en: T28: the submission links indexes 33 and 62 to the surnames in the reverse order from the register. The spelling of one of the two surnames also differs.
items.askSr: T28: koji član nosi 33, a koji 62, i kako se prezime tačno piše?
items.askEn: T28: which member holds 33 and which 62, and how is the surname spelled exactly?

items.sr: „Beogradski arhitriptih” — jedan 3D podnesak koji pokriva OŠ „Laza Kostić”, Silose i Sava centar stigao je bez imena i bez indeksa; propratni tekst je prazan fajl.

items.sr: Hotel Moskva: podnesak za objekat ne nosi indeks podnosioca, a oba tima na objektu (T29 i T54) u registru stoje bez potvrđenih indeksa.

items.askSr: Podnosilac za Hotel Moskvu: indeks i tim (T29 ili T54)?
items.askEn: Hotel Moskva submitter: index number and team (T29 or T54)?

items.sr: Prva beogradska gimnazija sada ima dva tima. Nosilac 93/2026 piše u množini, ali ostale članove ne imenuje; još jedan student radi na istom objektu, a nije ni u jednoj listi.

items.askSr: T69: ko su članovi? Student na istom objektu: u kom si timu?
items.askEn: T69: who are the members? Student on the same object: which team are you in?

items.sr: T38 (indeksi 10 i 27) potvrđen je od podnosioca, ali naziv predatog dokumenta govori o drugom objektu nego registar, koji nosi Vladičanski dvor u Vršcu. U samim mejlovima nova tema se ne pominje.
items.en: T38 (indexes 10 and 27) is confirmed by its submitters, but the submitted document’s filename names a different object than the register, which holds the Bishop’s Palace in Vršac. The mails themselves never mention a new topic.
items.askSr: T38: ostaje li Vladičanski dvor u Vršcu ili je tema promenjena?
items.askEn: T38: does the Bishop’s Palace in Vršac stand, or has the topic changed?

items.sr: Dva podneska vezana su samo objektom: Dve kule Beograd (→ T21) i Hotel Jugoslavija (→ T46). U oba slučaja tim je jedini na objektu, ali indeks nije naveden.

items.askSr: Podnosioci za Dve kule Beograd i Hotel Jugoslaviju: potvrdite broj indeksa i tim.
items.askEn: Submitters for Dve kule Beograd and Hotel Jugoslavija: confirm your index number and team.
